name: Rani Lakshmibai
role: Queen of Jhansi and iconic rebel commander
contribution: Rani Lakshmibai defended Jhansi and later led forces against the British during the 1857 rebellion in north-central India.
context: North and central India during the anti-colonial uprising of 1857-1859.
impact: Her military leadership and death in 1858 made her one of the most enduring figures in the public memory of the rebellion.
highlight: Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi became one of the best-known commanders of the 1857 rebellion.
seoTitle: Rani Lakshmibai: Jhansi and the 1857 Rebellion
seoDescription: Learn about Rani Lakshmibai's defense of Jhansi and military leadership during the Indian Rebellion of 1857.
shortAnswer: Rani Lakshmibai was the queen of Jhansi and a leading rebel commander during the 1857 uprising.
